text: Given your work as a nursing assistant and the symptoms of dark urine and jaundice, have you noticed any itching of the skin or pale-colored stools? I also need to know if you have had any recent exposures to blood or bodily fluids at work.

text: The lab results show significantly elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin, which strongly points to hepatitis rather than appendicitis. I will now request medical images to further evaluate the liver and surrounding structures. REQUEST IMAGES

text: The positive IgG indicates past exposure or vaccination, not acute infection, so we must check for active Hepatitis A. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis A IgM Antibody

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Hepatitis B surface antigen confirms an acute infection, which aligns with your occupational exposure and elevated liver enzymes. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis B
